testcase.name: Scenario: sweep-06 Cancel an edit after clearing the path: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/sweep/sweep.feature:65:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: sweep-06 Cancel an edit after clearing the path ✔ Given a disposable copy of the native fixture "fixtures/cad/sweep/circle-straight-path.opd" is open ✔ And the user creates Sweep1 from its circle profile and straight path with Follow Path orientation and 5 degrees taper ✔ And Sweep1 is open for editing with its profile and path selected ✔ When the path is cleared while editing ✔ Then the path selector requests a curve or edge ✔ And the solid preview disappears and OK is disabled ✔ When Cancel is clicked ✔ Then the existing Sweep1 solid returns ✔ And reopening Sweep1 shows its profile and path retained
